faq.a: Hikmet is associated with the Arabic form حِكْمَت, whose core sense is hikmet; wisdom (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Hikmet?
faq.a: Hikmet is associated with Arabic. Hikmet is the Turkish form of Arabic حِكْمَة (Ḥikma), meaning 'wisdom'.
Yes — the underlying form حِكْمَت is Arabic.
Hikmet can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hikmet should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ح ك م is Quranic (wisdom), but Ḥikma is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Hikmet mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Hikmet is rendered حکمت and carries the sense حکمت، دانائی.

faq.q: What does Hikmet mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hikmet is rendered حکمت and carries the sense حکمت، حکمت.
A romanized syllable approximation is hik-met. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hikmet?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hikmet, hikmet. Script forms are حِكْمَت, حکمت, हिकमत.

faq.q: Is Hikmet a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
